title: Rotor start while UAV is retained or a person is at the dock
mishap: Laceration or eye injury to maintainer or pilot; damage to dock

title: False retained state releases UAV under motion
mishap: UAV strikes pilot, crew or bystander; aircraft damaged

title: UAV launch or recovery outside the safe envelope
mishap: Rotor or airframe strike injuring pilot or crew

title: Person struck or pinned by the arms or claws
mishap: Fatal or disabling crush or impact injury to a person near the walker

title: Carried load swings, shifts or drops while walking
mishap: Fatal or disabling injury to a person struck by the load, or to the pilot in a resulting fall

title: Unintended leg motion during pilot ingress or egress
mishap: Crush or fall injury to pilot or ground crew during ingress/egress

title: Uncontrolled vertical drop of the cockpit on loss of leg support
mishap: Spinal compression, head or neck injury to the restrained pilot

title: Fall from height during emergency egress
mishap: Fatal or disabling fall injury to the pilot

title: Residual hydraulic pressure during maintenance
mishap: Crush or fluid-injection injury to maintainer

title: Battery thermal runaway near the pilot station
mishap: Burn or inhalation injury to the pilot or a maintainer; loss of the walker

title: Fuel leak and fire at the engine-generator
mishap: Burn injury to the pilot, a maintainer or ground crew

title: Protective stop does not reach a safe state
mishap: Fall, crush or impact injury to pilot or bystanders

title: Stale or lost feedback causes runaway motion
mishap: Walker fall or limb strike injuring pilot or bystanders

title: Walker tip-over or fall with pilot aboard
mishap: Pilot fatal or disabling injury in fall; crush of bystanders

title: Crushing under the pod or legs while kneeling or rising
